clientSideCompression.neverAppliesTo: discussion testimony video (already bounded server-side at 32MB)
clientSideCompression.owner: town-public (web only; mobile is out of scope for this stage)
clientSideCompression.trustBoundary: a client-side convenience only; server-side magic-byte, content-type, and size validation remains the sole authority and is unchanged by compression

costDecision.condition: this decision is conditional on the measured numbers, not an architectural default -- revisit if real traffic or cost materially exceeds the Etapa 4 assumption
costDecision.decision: signed URLs / private CDN are NOT implemented; the existing server-side proxy is sufficient at this cost and scale
costDecision.method: real k6 requests against the capacity environment at the byte sizes the browser compression step (PR #135) actually produces, real byteSize read back from server-side structured deployment logs, not assumed

description: Contract for member-signal and discussion-contribution media: upload validation, private object storage, TTL-bound pending uploads, and the public/private read distinction. Fixes byte-size caps, allowed content types, TTLs, and route shapes as a deliberate contract so future changes are intentional, mirroring the identity/auth-ceremony/membership/billing foundation contracts.

magicByteChecks.video/mp4: ftyp box marker ('ftyp' ASCII) present near the start of the file

discussionContributionMedia.readAuth: active session with participant civic access for the signal community

routeBodyLimit.rationale: set to the video cap for the whole route since content-type/kind is not known until after the body is parsed; an oversized image (over the 5MB image cap but under the 32MB route limit) is rejected by in-handler validation (400 VALIDATION_ERROR), while an oversized video (over 32MB) is rejected by the framework body limit before the handler runs (413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE)

discussionContributionMedia.visibility: private -- civic discussion evidence, not published content

explicitExclusions: signed GET URLs / private CDN (conditional on cost, not implemented -- see costDecision)
mobile (Flutter) media upload -- separate stage per project documentation
video for member-signal photos (member-signal media is photo-only)
server-side re-encoding or transcoding of uploaded media
GIF or other content types beyond the fixed allowlists above

memberSignalMedia.readAuth: none; no session check on the read route
memberSignalMedia.uploadAuth: active session with participant civic access for the target community
memberSignalMedia.visibility: public once the signal is published -- same visibility as the signal itself

oversizedPayload: test/discussion-session.media.api.test.ts (400, image over the image cap but under the route body limit)
test/discussion-session.media.api.test.ts (413, video over the route body limit)

participantGate.deniedIdentifiersExposed: none; bounded denial reason categories only, never leaked to the client
participantGate.ordering: object storage availability is checked before the session/participant gate; the participant gate runs before any contribution/upload lookup

storage.disabledBehavior: when OBJECT_STORAGE_ENABLED is false, the adapter is null and both upload routes fail with OBJECT_STORAGE_NOT_AVAILABLE (503) before any auth or participant check
storage.egressCost: R2 has zero egress fees, the basis for the Etapa 5 Step 3 decision below
storage.publicBucketPolicy: never a public bucket URL and never a permanent URL; every read is proxied through an authenticated (or intentionally public, for published member-signal photos) API route that streams bytes from storage
